documents.scope: One source-scoped primary route: electrode 4 made with equal 0.05 M cadmium nitrate and thiourea aqueous precursor concentrations, including the reported TiO2 electrode preparation. limitations: TiO2 paste formulations, printing passes/settings and substrate dimensions are not reported in the inspected main procedure; reference 37 remains unresolved.
Absolute cadmium nitrate and thiourea charges, aqueous bath volume, reagent hydration/purity and water grade are unreported.
Vessel material, capacity, closure, stirring, atmosphere, pressure and microwave temperature-control definition are unreported.
The microwave ramp and any post-deposition cooling, washing, drying, storage, isolated mass or yield are unreported; no such operations are invented.
Exact physical batch identity across microscopy, EDS and XRD is unreported; only the source electrode-4 class is explicitly shared.
No measured atomic coordinates, exact surface structure or resolved solution species are supplied in the core main scope.
